按钮暂不可用，请先完成页面要求。: This button is not available yet. Complete the page requirements first.
当前操作不在此处: This step is on another view
这段操作引导已结束: This part of the guide has ended
使用职业技能地图: Use the career and skills map
从你选的起点进入: Start from the option you chose
先选“方向未定”“已有目标”或“已有作品”，再点击这个入口。进入后，引导会接着指: Choose Explore, Have a goal, or Have existing work, then use this entry. Guidance will continue with the next control on the destination page.
点“了解工作”，查看日常任务和典型产物，再决定是否纳入比较。: Select Learn about the work to review daily tasks and typical outputs before choosing a direction to compare.
点这里查看需要哪些基础，以及已有材料能支持什么；没有材料的部分保持未知。: Open this tab to see relevant foundations and what your materials support. Missing evidence stays unknown.
把这个方向加入比较: Add this direction to your comparison
点“加入比较”保留候选。这一步只选比较方向，不会更改主目标。: Use Add to comparison to keep this candidate. This selects a comparison option without changing your main goal.
点“比较”，把候选放在同一口径下看差异。: Select Compare to review your candidates using the same criteria.
勾选第二个方向，至少两个方向才能比较；最多保留三个。: Select a second direction. Comparing requires at least two options; you can keep up to three.
写下问题，再暂存取舍: Write your question, then save your thinking
先填写比较区的问题与取舍，再点这里暂存。尚未决定也可以保存，不会替你确认目标。: Fill in the comparison question and trade-offs, then save them here. You can remain undecided; this does not confirm a goal for you.
点这里记录一段已经做过的经历，保存候选后再回来逐项确认。: Use this entry to record something you have actually done. Save a candidate, then return to confirm each item.
先填写经历标题与原文，再点这里保存。此时只是候选，还没有本人确认。: Enter a title and the original account, then save here. The record remains a candidate until you personally confirm it.
点这个页签查看待确认候选，接着逐项核对原文与本人贡献。: Use this tab to review candidate records and check the original account and your contribution one item at a time.
打开这一项，核对原文: Open this record to check it
点“修正 / 确认此项”，检查记录是不是自己做过的，以及本人负责的部分。: Select Correct / confirm this item. Check what actually happened and which part you personally contributed.
阅读弹窗中的原文、贡献和处置方式；确认无误再点这里。不要为了结束引导确认不真实的: Read the original account, contribution and resolution. Use this button when they are accurate; do not confirm inaccurate content to finish the guide.
点“职业评估”，选择想对照的职业。进入页面不会自动生成分析。: Open Career assessment and choose the career to compare. Visiting the page does not generate an analysis.
核对职业范围后点此按钮，生成基于当前确认材料的模拟对照。缺项继续保留未知。: Check the career scope, then use this button to generate a simulated comparison from current confirmed materials. Missing items stay unknown.
点这里填写一次行动的问题、交付物和预计投入，接着核对预算。: Use this control to enter a question, deliverable and estimated effort, then review the budget.
核对范围，再确认创建: Check the scope, then confirm creation
填写问题、交付物和预计投入。核对预算后点此按钮；超额或缺项时先按原提示调整，引导: Enter the question, deliverable and estimated effort. Check the budget before using this button. If requirements are missing or effort exceeds the budget, adjust them; guidance stays here.
点“继续任务”进入原任务，接着做；不需要为跟随引导重复创建任务。: Use the highlighted control to enter the existing task. There is no need to create a duplicate task to follow this guide.
点这里展开实践范围，看看要回答什么问题、需要哪些基础、最后留下什么。: Expand the practice scope to review the question, prerequisites and expected output.
选好范围，再进入预算预检: Choose the scope, then check the budget
在展开区选择本次范围，再点这里；阅读与预览都不会直接创建任务。: Choose a scope in the expanded area, then use this button. Reading and previewing do not create a task.
点这里填写实际产物、本人贡献和辅助来源。旧版本会保留。: Use this tab to enter the actual output, your contribution and assistance sources. Earlier versions are retained.
填写产物，再提交当前版本: Enter your output, then submit a version
填写上方产物后点此按钮提交一个版本；空内容会被原表单阻止，不会跳到下一步。: Complete the output field above and submit here. Empty content is blocked by the form, and the guide will stay on this step.
为刚提交的版本记录自检: Record a check for the submitted version
先核对对应版本，再点“记录本人自检”。这只是本人检查记录，不代表独立能力核验。: Review the corresponding version, then record your self-check. This records your own check, not independent competence verification.
点这里核对本人贡献、产物范围与辅助来源，为之后的成果确认留下依据。: Use this tab to review your contribution, output scope and assistance sources before confirming evidence later.
填写贡献后核对完成条件: Add your contribution, then check completion
补充本人实际做了什么，输入会自动保留。再点这里查看提交、自检和交付范围的完成条件: Describe what you actually did; input is saved automatically. Then review the submission, self-check and delivery conditions here.
逐项核对交付物后，再自行勾选这一项。勾选只表示本人自检，不代表外部能力认证。: Review each deliverable, then check this yourself. It records your own check, not an external competence certification.
条件满足后记录有限范围完成: Record limited completion once conditions are met
确认已有提交版本、本人贡献与对应自检后再点这里；条件不足时原页面会阻止完成，引导: Confirm you have a submitted version, your contribution and its self-check before using this button. Missing conditions still block completion; the guide never bypasses them.
点这里记录已经发生的过程与结果，尚未行动时可以返回计划。: Use this entry to record what actually happened. If you have not taken the action yet, you can return to the plan.
填写实际过程、产物与本人贡献，再用此按钮保存。未发生的部分不要补写。: Enter the process, output and your contribution, then save here. Do not fill in results that did not occur.
点复盘入口，留下实际结果、困难和下一次调整；不必把记录写成已核验成果。: Use the reflection entry to record results, difficulties and the next adjustment. Your account remains a personal record, not a verified achievement.
先检查这次报告的用途与缺项: Check the purpose and missing items first
点这里打开预检，选择要保留的章节与输出用途。: Open the preflight check here to select chapters and the intended output.
先确认缺项与输出范围: Check missing items and output scope
核对标题和章节，阅读缺项与模拟范围；理解后由你勾选。引导不会代替勾选。: Review the title and chapters and read the missing-data limitations. Check this yourself once understood; the guide never checks it for you.
确认范围，再建立报告草稿: Confirm the scope, then create a draft
填写标题，选择章节并阅读缺项说明；本人勾选后再点这里，建立一个保存版本。: Enter a title, choose chapters and read the limitations. After checking them yourself, use this button to save a version.
点这里选择导出片段。私人反思默认不包括在内，不会因为跟随引导自动选中。: Use this control to choose export sections. Private reflection is excluded by default and is never selected by following the guide.
在本弹窗核对片段和边界，再点此按钮下载本地示例。: Review the selected sections and limitations in this panel, then download the local sample here.
导出后回到报告: Return to the report after exporting
下载完成后，点这里关闭导出窗口，再回到报告；保存版本仍然保留。: Once the download is complete, close this export panel here to return to the report. The saved version is retained.
点这个板块入口去填写资料。保存候选并由本人确认后，再回简历编排。: Use this section entry to add a record. Save a candidate, confirm it yourself, then return to resume composition.
点这里展开内容设置。可选择目标、教育和确认材料，按需调整归类，不必填满所有板块。: Expand content settings here. Choose a target, education and confirmed records, then adjust sections as needed. Empty sections do not need filling.
选好材料后点这里，查看原文与拟输出措辞。没有材料时先回资料页补充。: Once materials are selected, open the original and proposed wording here. If there is no source material, add it on the records page first.
本人核对后保存一个版本: Review it yourself, then save a version
核对教育、经历与措辞；如有岗位改写，先确认表达没有超出事实，再点此按钮保存。: Check education, records and wording. If you used job-specific wording, confirm it stays within the facts, then save here.
回看刚保存的简历: Review the version you just saved
点这里查看保存版本并准备打印。以后修改资料不会悄悄改写这份快照。: Open the saved version here to prepare printing. Later edits to your records do not silently rewrite this snapshot.
看完预览后回到编辑台: Return to the editor after reviewing
核对保存版本，打印或下载由你自行选择。看完后点这里关闭预览，再继续其他准备。: Check the saved version and choose printing or downloading yourself. Close the preview here when finished, then continue your preparation.
点“透视工作”，按一次工作的过程看技能与产物。: Use this control to explore skills and outputs through the process of one task.
点“本次工具”展开SQL或表格的操作示例。选择方式和交付标准分别核对。: Open Current tool to see the SQL or spreadsheet examples. Review the tool choice and delivery requirements separately.
从当前节点准备一次实践: Prepare a practice from this node
点这里进入范围与预算预检，当前工具与支线会带入草稿，不会直接开始任务。: Open scope and budget preflight here. The current tool and branch are carried into the draft without starting a task.
先决定本次能用哪些资料: Choose what this discussion may use
点这里查看资料范围。可以只用通用知识，不必授权个人材料。: Review the scope here. General knowledge alone is available; personal materials are optional.
阅读弹窗并自行勾选；确认所选范围，或拒绝个人资料、只用通用知识，两种方式都可以继: Read and select the scope yourself. Confirm your selection or decline personal materials and use general knowledge. Either choice can continue.
输入具体问题，再发送: Write a specific question, then send
在问题框写清你想弄清的事，再点这里。回复为模拟结果，发送不会自动创建任务或更改目: Describe what you want to understand in the question field, then send here. Replies are simulated; sending does not create tasks or change goals.
先保存一份岗位原文: Save a job’s original requirements first
点这里填写你允许保存的岗位信息、来源和原文，未知字段可以留空。: Use this control to enter job information, sources and original requirements you may save. Unknown fields can stay empty.
核对来源与范围后保存: Check source and scope, then save
核对原文及本人处理范围，再点此按钮保存私人研究卡；保存不等于投递。: Check the original requirements and personal-use scope before saving this private research card. Saving does not submit an application.
为这份岗位编排简历: Compose a resume for this job
点这里把当前岗位带到简历，再自行选择有依据的教育、经历和表达。: Bring this job into the resume area here, then choose education, records and wording supported by your materials.
按需填写兴趣与约束，再点“保存偏好”。偏好不会自动改写已有计划或事实。: Edit interests and constraints as needed, then save here. Preferences do not automatically rewrite existing plans or facts.
点“资料授权”查看当前范围。是否调整由你自行决定，引导不会代替授权或删除数据。: Use Materials permissions to review the current scope. You decide whether to change it; the guide never authorizes access or deletes data for you.
先关联实际任务，填写结果、困难与下一调整，再点这里保存。尚未收到反馈可以留空。: Link an actual task and enter the result, difficulties and next adjustment, then save here. Feedback can stay empty if none was received.
把成果整理成待确认材料: Organize the output as evidence to confirm
点这里选择实际成果版本，说明它支持的技能范围与本人贡献。任务完成不会自动变成确认: Choose the actual output version here and describe the supported skill scope and your contribution. Completing a task does not automatically confirm evidence.
核对支持范围，再生成候选: Check the support scope, then create a candidate
在弹窗里核对版本、贡献与支持范围，再点这里生成候选；下一步仍要由本人逐项确认。: Review the version, contribution and support scope, then create a candidate here. The next step still requires your personal confirmation.
先把需求整理成筛选草稿: Turn your request into draft criteria
在需求框说明职业、地点或形式，再点这里生成可修改的模拟筛选条件。: Describe a career, location or work arrangement, then generate editable simulated search criteria here.
核对筛选条件，再确认检索: Review criteria before running the search
核对解析出的条件，未知可以保留；由你确认后再检索，不会自动保存或开启通知。: Check the parsed criteria and keep unknowns as needed. Confirm them yourself before searching; this does not save them or enable notifications.
如需重复使用，点这里保存已核对的条件；保存不会开启通知，也不代表发现真实在招岗位: Use this control to save reviewed criteria if you want to reuse them. Saving does not enable notifications or establish that real jobs are available.
